senses.gloss: (cmp. רָתַךְ, a. b. h. רָתַם) to join. Denom. מַרְתֵּף (cmp. כְּלוּב, אַכְלְבָא).

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 8:30">Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 30</cite> <he>לא יְרַתֵּף על גבו יין מפני שטוען וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. he must not store wine over it, because he overloads the walls; (oth. ed. <he>לא ירתף מפני שמכחישין וכ׳</he> he must not turn the dwelling into a store house, because they (the stored things) weaken &c.
